Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Job Description

Design, enhance and maintain internal websites, web applications and stand-alone Python applications. Full stack capability is required. You will design and implement both the front-end user interface and back-end application and database. The front-end is currently FastAPI and Vue 3. The back-end environment is currently Red Hat Linux and Microsoft SQL Server. We will be moving to cloud-based solutions such as AWS, Azure, and Snowflake.

Personal Characteristics

Demonstrated technical leadership
Entrepreneurial spirit
Drives projects to completion
Strong problem solving skills
Excellent verbal and written communications skills
Intellectually curious and passionate
High emotional intelligence and solid people skills
Qualifications

Skills and Experience

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or Engineering
3+ years of industry experience as a full stack web developer
Expert in Object Oriented Python, JavaScript, node.js, SQL
Test-driven development
Full stack front-end & back-end web application development
Must have experience with application architecture design
HTML5, CSS, jquery, Ajax, Flask, FastAPI, Vue.js
Microsoft SQL server, SQL database
Web technologies such as RESTful APIs, JSON, WebSocket, sockets
Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Snowflake.
Git version control
Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Technical writing for project proposals, documentation and test
Desired: data analytics, HighCharts, AG-grid controls
